title: Uniquely Owned Rc
goal: Mutate an Rc inner value when no other references exist.
hints: Rc does not allow mutating inner values directly because another handle might be reading.
`Rc::get_mut` succeeds only when the strong reference count is exactly 1.
explanation: `Rc::get_mut` checks the reference count at runtime. It returns `Some(&mut T)` only when the `Rc` is uniquely owned. Trying `Some(num)` attempts to add `1` directly to `Rc<i32>`, causing `E0368`. Calling `num.as_mut()` fails with `E0599` because `Rc` does not implement `AsMut`. Trying `*num` fails with `E0507` because moving out of a mutable reference is forbidden. Passing `num` directly fails with `E0308` due to a type mismatch.
